title: Piety, mother of the virtues; knowing God
english: Piety must be cared for above all — rightly called mother of the virtues, for it is their beginning and their end. Both sight and the natural law teach knowledge of God, the cause that holds all things together and makes them: sight by striking what is seen and fixed; the law by reasoning from the seen and ordered things up to their leader.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: Open-air faith; three gathered in the Lord
english: Better is open-air faith than costly piety — and [[three gathered in the Lord’s name >> Bible:Matthew 18:20]] than many who deny the Godhead.

title: Purified word; piety the lasting good
english: Nothing is so magnificent toward God as a purified word and a soul perfected in the doctrines of truth. The only unchanging and enduring good is piety.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: What envy will not trust
english: What cannot be reached is somehow also not trusted, because of envy — for to profane souls nothing fine is credible.
